description.value: Nature's Fare Markets is a BC natural and organic grocery chain with a strong commitment to certified-organic, non-GMO, and locally sourced products, banning over 500 ingredients from its shelves. The West Kelowna location has operated since 2008 and includes an in-store Bistro offering grab-and-go prepared foods and smoothies made with local and organic ingredients. Cyclists will find a wide range of organic produce, health foods, vitamins, supplements, and ready-to-eat options under one roof.

address.value: 104-3480 Carrington Road, West Kelowna, BC V4T 3C1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for the West Kelowna store page confirms the business is active and operational, with address, phone, and hours all matching the OSM record. The store page lists 'Free parking' under Fast Facts but makes no mention of bike-specific parking or water bottle refill. Basic groceries are confirmed by the extensive product listing (organic produce, meat, dairy, supplements, etc.), and a Bistro is mentioned offering grab-and-go prepared items and smoothies, but no explicit confirmation of hot food service. No website evidence exists for washrooms, ice, vending machines, camping fuel, bike infrastructure, or charging amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible grocery store with confirmed address, phone, and website. Useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in West Kelowna.
